conservation_status.description: This species is endemic to a relatively small area with an area of occupancy smaller than 2,000 km² and the populations are severely fragmented. It has quite a narrow ecological tolerance and has clearly declined throughout much of its range due to threats such as pollution, changes of the hydrological regime of water bodies, and infrastructure development. It is therefore classed as Vulnerable.
